newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA CBANK SAYS CUTS MAIN INTEREST RATE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA CBANK SAYS CUTS MAIN INTEREST RATE.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday it cut the simple annual main interest rate to 6.12 percent from 6.96 percent effective from Monday.
"The BNB board decided at its meeting to cut the simple annual main interest rate to 6.12 percent from July 21," a BNB statement said.

The rate is calculated on the average yield to maturity on three-month discount T-bills. The BNB has cut the rate once weekly in the past month shadowing an excessive lev liqidity on the domestic money market. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
